lines: # Folder map
What each folder is for. Read this before adding a file.
- `refs/`: Reference tracks and notes on what to borrow. Read-only.
- `library/`: Material shared across songs: samples, presets and templates.
- `library/samples/`: Licensed one-shots and loops with licences. Read-only.
- `library/presets/`: Synth, plugin and channel-strip presets.
- `library/templates/`: DAW session templates.
- `songs/`: One folder per song, named by slug; copy _template/ to start a song.
- `songs/_template/`: Copy this folder to songs/<slug>/ to start a song.
- `songs/_template/lyrics/`: Drafts and the final lyrics.md.
- `songs/_template/prompts/`: Style prompt, tags and settings per generation.
- `songs/_template/gens/`: Raw AI generations, every take. Ignored by Git and disposable.
- `songs/_template/selects/`: Chosen takes, renamed, with source prompt noted.
- `songs/_template/recordings/`: Raw vocal and instrument takes. Read-only.
- `songs/_template/session/`: DAW project and its bundled audio.
- `songs/_template/midi/`: Exported .mid parts.
- `songs/_template/stems/`: Per-part bounces, same start point and same length.
- `songs/_template/mixes/`: Versioned mix bounces: slug_mix_v03.wav.
- `songs/_template/masters/`: Mastered files per target format.
- `songs/_template/bounces/`: Quick reference exports. Ignored by Git and disposable.
- `artwork/`: Cover art sources and working exports; final covers in releases/<release>/art/.
- `releases/`: One folder per single, EP or album; copy _template/ to start a release.
- `releases/_template/`: Copy this folder to releases/<release>/ to start a release.
- `releases/_template/audio/`: Final masters in track order with release filenames.
- `releases/_template/art/`: 3000x3000 cover and platform variants.
- `releases/_template/metadata/`: Credits, ISRC, UPC, splits, lyrics and descriptions.
- `releases/_template/promo/`: Clips, canvases and press text.
- `cache/`: DAW cache, freeze and analysis files. Ignored by Git and disposable.

purpose: Start a song by copying `songs/_template/` to `songs/<slug>/`. Start a release by copying `releases/_template/` to `releases/<release>/`, only after approval.
rules: - Each folder's purpose is in `FOLDERS.md`; read it before adding a file.
- Raw generations go in `songs/<slug>/gens/`; copy keepers to `songs/<slug>/selects/` and log the prompt in `songs/<slug>/prompts/`.
- Never edit or delete files in `songs/<slug>/recordings/` or `library/samples/`.
- Files in `songs/<slug>/mixes/` and `songs/<slug>/masters/` are never overwritten; increment the version (`_v01`, `_v02`).
- All stems for one song start at bar 1, share one length, one sample rate and one bit depth.
- A master is made only from an approved mix; record which mix in `songs/<slug>/song.yaml`.
- Working audio is WAV 24-bit, except raw generations in `songs/<slug>/gens/`, which stay in the format the generator produced; other lossy formats are made only for `releases/`.
- Final lyrics live in `songs/<slug>/lyrics/lyrics.md`; that file is copied unchanged into `releases/<release>/metadata/`.
- Creating a `releases/<release>/` folder or uploading to a distributor needs approval.
- Every sample or loop used must have a licence in `library/samples/`.
- Run `git lfs install` once before the first commit.
